description: This file contains PHP code for interacting with the Redmine issue tracker through the TestLink platform. It includes setup for configuration, creation of issue tracker interface objects, and test calls to fetch and add issues from/to Redmine.

classes.name: redminerestInterface
classes.description: A class presumably providing methods to interact with Redmine's REST API, including connection verification and issue management.

classes.name: tlIssueTracker
classes.description: A class from the TestLink platform managing issue tracker integrations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method for initializing the interface with configuration parameters.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the interface is connected to the Redmine server.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific issue by its ID from Redmine.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in Redmine with specified subject and description.
